source: In a file, {0} is a key, {1} is one key per quantity ({2}), and {3} is one key per item ({4}). Deleting an item before the end empties it, so later items keep their index. {5} is not a message, and x18n does not write to it. A comment right above an entry is its description for translators. x18n reads and writes Android's escapes ({6}, {7}, {8}, a leading {9}), keeps inline markup such as {10}, and keeps CDATA.
text: 在檔案中，{0} 是一個鍵，{1} 是每個數量對應一個鍵（{2}），{3} 是每個項目對應一個鍵（{4}）。若刪除的項目不是最後一項，該項目會被清空，因此後面的項目會保留原本的索引。{5} 不是訊息，x18n 也不會寫入它。位於項目正上方的註解會作為給翻譯人員的說明。x18n 會讀取並寫入 Android 的跳脫字元（{6}、{7}、{8}、開頭的 {9}），保留 {10} 這類行內標記，並保留 CDATA。
